id: \bHello. I used to be a Stats Judge, but my job became obsolete when Trainers became able to see a Pokémon's potential on their own. Now I'm retired...
en: \bHello. I used to be a Stats Judge, but my job became obsolete when Trainers became able to see a Pokémon's potential on their own. Now I'm retired...
it: \bSalve. Un tempo ero un Giudice delle Statistiche, ma il mio lavoro è diventato inutile quando gli Allenatori hanno imparato a vedere da soli il potenziale dei Pokémon. Ora sono in pensione...

id: \bHold on a minute... your future. It's brilliant! Yes, I can just tell!
en: \bHold on a minute... your future. It's brilliant! Yes, I can just tell!
it: \bAspetta un attimo... il tuo futuro. È brillante! Sì, lo sento!

id: \bTrainer... go out there and find some Pokémon!
en: \bTrainer... go out there and find some Pokémon!
it: \bAllenatore... vai là fuori e trova qualche Pokémon!

id: \bI see you achieved that brilliant future.
en: \bI see you achieved that brilliant future.
it: \bVedo che hai raggiunto quel futuro brillante.

id: It's notes on how to win a Cool Contest.
en: It's notes on how to win a Cool Contest.
it: Sono appunti su come vincere una Gara Classe.

id: \bI've been entering contests since I was a young lad. I even managed to win against Wallace once. My grandkid has taken it up now.
en: \bI've been entering contests since I was a young lad. I even managed to win against Wallace once. My grandkid has taken it up now.
it: \bPartecipo alle gare da quando ero un ragazzino. Una volta sono persino riuscito a battere Adriano. Ora ha preso il testimone mio nipote.

id: \bWhat? You want to go to Mossdeep City?
en: \bWhat? You want to go to Mossdeep City?
it: \bCosa? Vuoi andare a Verdeazzupoli?

id: \bWell if you're good enough to beat me I might let you use my ship. How about it?
en: \bWell if you're good enough to beat me I might let you use my ship. How about it?
it: \bBeh, se sei abbastanza bravo da battermi, potrei lasciarti usare la mia nave. Che ne dici?

id: \bI guess you're good enough. Let's ship out.
en: \bI guess you're good enough. Let's ship out.
it: \bDirei che sei all'altezza. Salpiamo.

id: \bWell fine. I didn't want to go anyways.
en: \bWell fine. I didn't want to go anyways.
it: \bE va bene. Tanto non volevo andarci.

id: \bHello, hello!\nI am the official Name Rater!
en: \bHello, hello!\nI am the official Name Rater!
it: \bSalve, salve!\nSono il Giudice dei Nomi ufficiale!

id: \bWant me to rate the nicknames of your Pokémon?
en: \bWant me to rate the nicknames of your Pokémon?
it: \bVuoi che valuti i soprannomi dei tuoi Pokémon?

id: \bWhich Pokémon's nickname should I critique?
en: \bWhich Pokémon's nickname should I critique?
it: \bDi quale Pokémon devo giudicare il soprannome?

id: \bI see.\nDo come visit again.
en: \bI see.\nDo come visit again.
it: \bCapisco.\nTorna pure a trovarmi.

id: \bNow, now... That is merely an Egg!
en: \bNow, now... That is merely an Egg!
it: \bSu, su... Quello è soltanto un Uovo!

id: \bI wouldn't dare critique a Shadow Pokémon's name!
en: \bI wouldn't dare critique a Shadow Pokémon's name!
it: \bNon oserei mai giudicare il nome di un Pokémon Ombra!

id: \b\v[3], is it?\nThat is a decent nickname!
en: \b\v[3], is it?\nThat is a decent nickname!
it: \b\v[3], eh?\nÈ un soprannome discreto!

id: \bBut, would you like me to give it a nicer name?
en: \bBut, would you like me to give it a nicer name?
it: \bMa vorresti che gli dessi un nome più bello?

id: \bHow about it?
en: \bHow about it?
it: \bChe ne dici?

id: \bAh, good. Then, what shall the new nickname be?
en: \bAh, good. Then, what shall the new nickname be?
it: \bAh, bene. Allora, quale sarà il nuovo soprannome?

id: \bI see. You're right, there's no need to change this Pokémon's nickname.
en: \bI see. You're right, there's no need to change this Pokémon's nickname.
it: \bCapisco. Hai ragione, non c'è bisogno di cambiare il soprannome di questo Pokémon.

id: \bIt already had a superb name!
en: \bIt already had a superb name!
it: \bAveva già un nome superbo!

id: \bDone! From now on, this Pokémon shall be known as \v[3]!
en: \bDone! From now on, this Pokémon shall be known as \v[3]!
it: \bFatto! D'ora in poi, questo Pokémon si chiamerà \v[3]!

id: \bIt looks no different from before, and yet, this is vastly superior!
en: \bIt looks no different from before, and yet, this is vastly superior!
it: \bSembra uguale a prima, eppure è di gran lunga superiore!

id: \bHow fortunate for you!
en: \bHow fortunate for you!
it: \bChe fortuna per te!

id: \bDone! From now on, this Pokémon shall be known as \v[5]!
en: \bDone! From now on, this Pokémon shall be known as \v[5]!
it: \bFatto! D'ora in poi, questo Pokémon si chiamerà \v[5]!

id: \bIt is a better name than before!\nHow fortunate for you!
en: \bIt is a better name than before!\nHow fortunate for you!
it: \bÈ un nome migliore di prima!\nChe fortuna per te!

id: \bThere is a ship around here that will take you around Hoenn. Though he is hard to please.
en: \bThere is a ship around here that will take you around Hoenn. Though he is hard to please.
it: \bQui in giro c'è una nave che può portarti in giro per Hoenn. Però il capitano è difficile da accontentare.

id: \bI've always wanted to sell items. Is that strange?
en: \bI've always wanted to sell items. Is that strange?
it: \bHo sempre voluto vendere strumenti. È strano?
